subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern / Air China / China Eastern
overview: Fly to Xining and travel by private coach through Qinghai and Gansu: Qinghai Lake, the Chaka Salt Lake, the Mogao Grottoes, Mingsha Mountain and Crescent Moon Spring, Jiayuguan and the colourful Zhangye Danxia. Hotels are local 5★ (4★ in Chaka) and the guide is English-speaking. Flights go via Guangzhou, Beijing or Shanghai depending on the departure and airline.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Oct 24–31 2026 to Nov 21–28 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Xining
items: Fly to Xining via Guangzhou (China Southern), Beijing (Air China) or Shanghai (China Eastern), depending on the departure date
Arrive in Xining and meet the English-speaking guide
Transfer to the hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Xining – Qinghai Lake – Chaka
items: Qinghai Lake Erlangjian Scenic Area (including electric car)

itinerary.title: Chaka – Golmud
items: Chaka Salt Lake (including one-way small train and shoe covers)

itinerary.title: Golmud – Dunhuang
items: Shazhou Night Market, to taste local snacks

itinerary.title: Dunhuang
items: Mogao Grottoes (including digital movies and shuttle buses)
Mingsha Mountain and Crescent Moon Spring (including electric car, shoe covers and camel ride)
Statue of Emperor Wu of Han Dynasty

itinerary.title: Dunhuang – Jiayuguan – Zhangye
items: The Child of Earth, a desert sculpture symbolizing rebirth
Jiayuguan Ancient City Wall (including ticket and electric car)

itinerary.title: Zhangye – Xining
items: Pass through the Qilian Mountains grassland
Return to Xining by bus and bullet train

itinerary.title: Xining – Manila
items: Transfer to the airport according to the flight time and fly home via Guangzhou, Beijing or Shanghai

placeDesc.Moji Street Night Market: A busy night-market street in Xining with local snacks, visited on arrival.
placeDesc.Qinghai Lake: China's largest lake, a high-altitude lake on the Tibetan Plateau.
placeDesc.Erlangjian Scenic Area: A scenic area on the shore of Qinghai Lake, toured with an electric car.
placeDesc.Chaka Salt Lake: A salt lake famous for mirror-like reflections, visited with a one-way small train.
placeDesc.Qarhan Salt Lake: A huge salt lake in the Qaidam Basin, toured with an electric shuttle.
placeDesc.Shazhou Night Market: A night market in Dunhuang for tasting local snacks.
placeDesc.Mogao Grottoes: A famed complex of Buddhist cave temples and murals near Dunhuang, with a digital film and shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Mingsha Mountain: Towering sand dunes near Dunhuang, with a camel ride included.
placeDesc.Crescent Moon Spring: A crescent-shaped spring among the Mingsha Mountain dunes near Dunhuang.
placeDesc.Jiayuguan Ancient City Wall: The historic fortress gate at the western end of the Ming Great Wall, visited with an electric car.
placeDesc.Ganzhou Night Market: A night market in Zhangye with local street food.
placeDesc.Zhangye Colorful Danxia: A landscape of rainbow-striped rock hills in Zhangye.
placeDesc.Qilian Mountains Grassland: Wide grassland scenery passed on the way back to Xining.
